info.description: One class and its published syllabus — either an uploaded PDF or a link to one. ⚠ With neither, the card says the syllabus is issued by the school instead of pretending to be a download.

file.description: Upload the syllabus PDF here. This is the simplest way — the card links to it and prints its size on its own. If a file is uploaded it is used, and the link below is ignored.

href.description: Or paste a link to a PDF already published elsewhere. Only used when no file is uploaded above. Leave both empty and the card says the syllabus is issued by the school.

sizeMb.description: Only needed for a pasted link — an uploaded file reports its own size. Megabytes, printed on the card so a parent on mobile data can see it before opening.
